source_evidence: User explicit instructions in current conversation, 2026-10-30

site_scope.notes: Use public projects page https://www.freelancermap.com/projects; no other search surface selected.

workplace.validation: Use the actual Workplace control; require only Remote selected. A title containing 'Remote' is insufficient if the listing badge says On-site/Hybrid. If results contradict active filters, report mismatch, do not assert eligibility.

contract_type.validation: Use site Contract type and require only Freelance selected; do not include permanent or agency-contract results.

country.validation: No Country entries selected. Disable 'Exclude projects from German speaking countries' if active, including when it appears as an active chip. Do not reject country-labeled advertisements at search stage.

sort.notes: Do not force Newest or Relevant; sorting is not an opportunity filter.

observed_site_filters_and_unresolved_sel.field: Exclude projects from German speaking countries

filter_application_procedure: Clear any preselected workplace, contract, country or extra active chips, including Exclude projects from German speaking countries; never assume unselected from filter counter alone.
Select only Workplace=Remote and Contract type=Freelance.
Do not select a country or turn on any exclusion; keep all countries including Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
Do not impose publication date, industry, professional fields, keyword, end-client only or sort restrictions.
Verify applied controls/chips: Remote and Freelance only; no Hybrid/On-site/Permanent/Agency or regional exclusion.
For inconsistent result badges, note the discrepancy; do not treat a title containing Remote as proof of remote status.
Do not infer worldwide work eligibility from any-country search; eligibility assessment is a separate future step.
After applying filters, report displayed result count as an observation with timestamp; never hardcode count.
blocked_until_next_user_instructions: Result pagination depth or volume, scan schedule, capture and storage of live opportunities.
Detail reading, shortlist/rejection, pricing/skills/work eligibility evaluation.
execution_contract.dynamic_counts: No fixed counts: results change as the site updates.
